items.source: 北京青年报 / 河北日报
items.summary: 22号线（平谷线）平谷段四站四区间建设已全部完成，其中马坊物流港站、马昌营站、平谷站已通过工程验收，站内装修和出入口建设均已完成，站前广场完成80%，区间铺轨、电力架设、信号安装全部完成，目前正在进行通车试运行。红庙至平谷段8月25日已进入空载试运行，全线20座车站主体结构封顶、附属结构完成96%、设备安装装修完成90%，年底基本具备开通条件。11月26日，北京青年报实地探访确认，位于平谷区的马坊物流港站、马昌营站、国农港站、平谷站四座车站已全部建成，线路正在进行通车试运行；马昌营站东侧约5.5万平方米的停车场地面铺设已完成、正在进行彩喷，沿线乡镇正同步推进站前环境整治与停车换乘等配套准备。11月24日，支持河北段建设的45.5亿元银团贷款成功落地，由建行廊坊分行牵头、7家银行组建，截至目前已累计投放13.66亿元，为河北段盾构掘进、车站封顶和空载试运行提供了资金保障。通车后平谷城区到红庙站约53分钟，燕郊至北京城市副中心最快9分钟，将大幅缓解跨省通勤压力；官方尚未公布具体开通日期。
items.summary_en: Construction of the four stations and four sections on the Pinggu stretch of Line 22 (Pinggu Line) is complete: Mafang Logistics Port, Machangying and Pinggu stations have passed project acceptance, with station fitting-out and entrances finished, station squares 80% done, and track laying, power and signalling all complete; trial running ahead of opening is under way. The Hongmiao–Pinggu section entered no-load trial operation on 25 August, with all 20 station structures topped out, ancillary works 96% complete and equipment and finishing 90% complete; it should basically be ready to open by year-end. On 26 November, Beijing Youth Daily reported from the site that all four Pinggu District stations — Mafang Logistics Port, Machangying, Guononggang and Pinggu — are now fully built and the line is in trial running; the roughly 55,000 sq m car park east of Machangying station has been paved and is being colour-sprayed, while townships along the line are upgrading station surroundings and park-and-ride facilities. On 24 November, a ¥4.55 billion syndicated loan backing the Hebei section was finalised, led by CCB's Langfang branch with seven banks; ¥1.366 billion has been disbursed so far, funding shield tunnelling, station topping-out and trial running on the Hebei stretch. Once open, Pinggu to Hongmiao will take about 53 minutes, and Yanjiao to Beijing's sub-centre as little as 9 minutes, easing cross-province commuting; no exact opening date has been announced yet.
items.title: 北京22号线预计2026年底开通
items.title_en: Beijing Line 22 expected to open by end of 2026

items.source: 上海轨道交通 / 上海崇明
items.summary: 22号线（崇明线）全长约42.9公里、设8座车站，自浦东金吉路至崇明裕安，最高时速120公里，是上海首条跨长江地铁线，2026年4月已实现全线轨道贯通，目前正推进车辆交付与调试，力争年底具备开通条件。首批7列车已交付，列车采用GoA4全自动无人驾驶系统，车厢首次设置弧形“家庭座”，高峰6节、低谷3节灵活编组，出现小故障可无感持续运行并自行回库检修。通车后崇明将首次接入上海地铁网，东滩至浦东金桥约30分钟。
items.summary_en: Line 22 (Chongming Line) runs about 42.9 km with 8 stations, from Jinji Road in Pudong to Yu'an on Chongming Island, at up to 120 km/h — Shanghai's first metro line across the Yangtze. Track laying finished in April 2026 and vehicle delivery and testing are under way, aiming to be ready for opening by year-end. The first seven trainsets have been delivered; they run in GoA4 fully automatic mode, with the first-ever curved 'family seats' in the cars and flexible 3-car off-peak / 6-car peak formation, and can keep running through minor faults and return to the depot unaided. Once open, Chongming joins the Shanghai metro network for the first time, with Dongtan to Jinqiao in about 30 minutes.
items.title: 上海22号线预计2026年底开通
items.title_en: Shanghai Line 22 expected to open by end of 2026

items.source: 广州地铁 / 广州日报
items.summary: 12号线中段（广州体育馆—二沙岛）全长8.8公里、设7座车站，土建工程已基本完成，10月31日起与东西两段启动贯通跑图试运行；11月20日，广州地铁确认中段7座车站及轨行区已全部完成临时“三权”移交，正开展系统综合联调及不载客试运行。建设六马路站将与五号线淘金站实现付费区换乘。按计划年底开通后，12号线将实现浔峰岗至大学城南全线贯通，广州地铁运营里程将迈上800公里新台阶。
items.summary_en: The 8.8 km, 7-station middle section of Line 12 (Guangzhou Gymnasium – Ersha Island) has largely finished civil works and began through trial running with the east and west sections on 31 October; on 20 November Guangzhou Metro confirmed all seven stations and the track area have completed the provisional handover of the three management rights, and system integration testing and no-load trial running are now under way. Jianshe Liulu station will offer a paid-area interchange with Line 5’s Taojin station. Once it opens by year-end as planned, Line 12 will run through from Xunfenggang to Higher Education Mega Center South, and Guangzhou’s network will pass 800 km.
items.title: 广州12号线中段预计2026年底开通
items.title_en: Guangzhou Line 12 (middle section) expected to open by end of 2026

items.source: 广州地铁 / 广州日报
items.summary: 13号线二期西段（鸦岗—天河公园）全长25.3公里、设19座车站，10月24日起进入贯通跑图试运行，11月15日全部车站完成移交运营调试，11月16日跑图阶段结束；11月20日，广州地铁确认19座车站及轨行区已全部完成临时“三权”移交，正开展系统综合联调及不载客试运行，同日移交的还有建设六马路站、仓边路站。自11月17日起，既有13号线（天河公园至新沙）列车到发时刻相应调整，天河公园站乘客下车站台也有所调整，广州地铁提醒乘客提前留意站内指引。按计划年底开通后，13号线将实现朝阳至鱼珠全线贯通，有助于分流5号线东西向通勤压力，广州地铁运营里程将迈上800公里新台阶。
items.summary_en: The 25.3 km, 19-station western section of Line 13 Phase 2 (Yagang – Tianhe Park) began through trial running on 24 October; all 19 stations were handed over for operational testing on 15 November and the trial-running phase ended on 16 November. On 20 November Guangzhou Metro confirmed all 19 stations and the track area have completed the provisional handover of the three management rights, with system integration testing and no-load trial running under way; Jianshe Liulu and Cangbianlu stations were handed over the same day. From 17 November, timetables on the existing Line 13 (Tianhe Park – Xinsha) were adjusted and the alighting platform at Tianhe Park changed, with passengers advised to check station signs. Once it opens by year-end as planned, Line 13 will run through from Chaoyang to Yuzhu, easing east–west commuter pressure on Line 5, and Guangzhou’s network will pass 800 km.

items.title_en: Guangzhou Line 13 Phase 2 (west section) expected to open by end of 2026

items.summary: 13号线二期（南延）始于东角头站、终于深圳湾口岸站，全长约4.1公里，全线地下敷设、设站3座，建成后将进一步满足南山蛇口片区市民的出行需求。目前车站主体已全部完成，正按计划推进，预计2027年开通。13号线一期南段已于2024年底投入运营，全线于2025年底贯通，北延段于2026年6月28日开通。
items.summary_en: The south extension of Line 13 Phase 2 runs from Dongjiaotou to Shenzhen Bay Checkpoint, about 4.1 km fully underground with 3 stations, and will further serve travel demand in Shekou, Nanshan, once open. Station structures are now 100% complete and work is proceeding as planned towards a 2027 opening. The southern section of Line 13 Phase 1 entered service at the end of 2024, the full Phase 1 line opened at the end of 2025, and the northern extension opened on 28 June 2026.

items.summary: 27003车、27004车已于近日运抵璧山停车场并完成吊装落轨，车辆接收取得阶段性进展，为后续车辆调试、全线联调联试打下基础。27号线全长约56公里、设15座车站，设计时速140公里，仍按计划推进，预计2027年开通。
items.summary_en: Trains 27003 and 27004 have arrived at the Bishan depot and been lifted onto the tracks, a milestone in vehicle delivery ahead of testing and full-line joint commissioning. Line 27 runs about 56 km with 15 stations at a design speed of 140 km/h, and remains on schedule for a 2027 opening.

items.summary: Z2线一期是串联天津中心城区与滨海新区的骨干轨道交通线路，沿线串联空港经济区、经开区西区、高新区渤龙湖科技园、滨海—中关村科技园等重点产业片区。11月19日，洞庭路站跨洞庭路连续梁施工顺利完成，较既定节点提前13天，标志着该项目重难点跨路施工取得关键性突破，为后续区间结构贯通创造了条件。线路仍按计划推进，预计2027年开通。
items.summary_en: Line Z2 Phase 1 is the backbone metro line linking central Tianjin with Binhai New Area, serving the Airport Economic Zone, the western Tianjin Economic-Technological Development Area, the Bolonghu Science Park and the Binhai–Zhongguancun Science Park. On 19 November, the continuous beam crossing Dongting Road at Dongtinglu station was completed, 13 days ahead of schedule — a breakthrough on one of the project’s hardest road-crossing sections, paving the way for the remaining structural works. The line remains on schedule for a 2027 opening.
items.title: 天津Z2线预计2027年开通
items.title_en: Tianjin Line Z2 expected to open in 2027

items.summary: 沈阳市民政局近日发布公告，公布多座地铁站的正式站名：6号线文萃路站更名为自动化所机器人中心站，10号线的15座车站完成定名，其中8座与施工期使用的工程名不同。辽宁日报11月26日报道称，新站名突出沈阳的科创特色——自动化所机器人中心站呼应沈阳作为我国第一台工业机器人样机诞生地的产业历史，10号线自动化所鲁美学院站将科研机构与艺术院校并置；原丁香街站改名为大格站，既避免与既有丁香湖站混淆，也让传统聚落地名重新进入公众视野。沈阳地铁已逐字逐词解读此次站名取舍的缘由，乘客出行时请以最新站名和站内指引为准。
items.summary_en: Shenyang's Civil Affairs Bureau has announced official names for a batch of metro stations: Line 6's Wencuilu station becomes Zidonghuasuo Jiqiren Zhongxin (Automation Institute Robot Centre), and 15 Line 10 stations have been formally named, eight of them differently from their construction-period names. Liaoning Daily reported on 26 November that the new names highlight the city's science-and-technology identity — the robot-centre name recalls Shenyang as the birthplace of China's first industrial-robot prototype, and Line 10's Zidonghuasuo Lumei Xueyuan pairs a research institute with an art academy; the former Dingxiangjie station is renamed Dage, avoiding confusion with the existing Dingxianghu station and reviving a traditional settlement name. Shenyang Metro has published a character-by-character explanation of the choices; passengers should follow the latest station names and signage.
items.title: 沈阳地铁公布新站名：6号线文萃路站更名为自动化所机器人中心站
items.title_en: Shenyang Metro announces new station names: Line 6's Wencuilu becomes Automation Institute Robot Centre

items.summary: 11月24日，哈尔滨地铁集团发行2026年第二次电子30次计次票，售价80元，激活后360日内可不限里程乘坐地铁30次，折合单次约2.67元。本次分两期发行、每期1万张、售完即止：第一期11月24日22:00起发售，第二期11月27日22:00起发售。乘客需通过“哈尔滨城市通”App注册并实名认证后，在“优惠定期票”中购买，乘车时在App乘车码页面选定该票扫码过闸；购票后超过30日未激活将自动退票退款，电子票仅限本人使用。
items.summary_en: On 24 November, Harbin Metro Group issued its second electronic 30-ride pass of 2026, priced at ¥80 for 30 unlimited-distance rides within 360 days of activation — about ¥2.67 per ride. The passes are released in two batches of 10,000 each while stocks last: the first from 22:00 on 24 November and the second from 22:00 on 27 November. Riders buy through the Harbin City Pass app after registration and real-name verification (under “discount passes”), then select the pass on the app’s QR-code page at the gates; passes not activated within 30 days of purchase are refunded automatically, and the e-pass is for the named holder only.
items.title: 哈尔滨地铁发行30次计次票：80元享360天内30次不限里程
items.title_en: Harbin Metro issues 30-ride pass: ¥80 for 30 unlimited-distance rides in 360 days

items.summary: 日前正式发布的《北京市“十五五”时期现代综合交通运输体系发展规划》明确，到2030年，北京城市轨道交通运营里程将达1050公里以上，较2025年底的909公里新增140多公里。北京市交通委相关负责人解读称，北京将通过新线建设“补空白”、存量线路“提效率”实现这一目标，重点推进1号线支线、3号线一期剩余段、22号线（平谷线）、28号线（CBD线）、13号线扩能提升工程、城市副中心M101线一期等线路建设，并加快亦庄线与5号线、10号线联络线等工程。规划还提出对环京通勤廊道实行“一廊一策”分类提速，其中东向国贸—通州—燕郊廊道重点加快22号线建设，以缓解潮汐式通勤压力。
items.summary_en: The newly released Beijing 15th Five-Year Plan for a modern comprehensive transport system sets a target of more than 1,050 km of urban rail in operation by 2030, up from 909 km at the end of 2025. The Beijing Municipal Commission of Transport said the city will fill network gaps with new lines — including the Line 1 branch, the remaining section of Line 3 Phase 1, Line 22 (Pinggu Line), Line 28 (CBD Line), the Line 13 capacity upgrade and the M101 Line Phase 1 in the sub-centre — while improving efficiency on existing lines, and will build links between the Yizhuang Line and Lines 5 and 10. The plan also applies a corridor-by-corridor approach to commuting around Beijing, with the eastward Guomao–Tongzhou–Yanjiao corridor prioritising faster construction of Line 22 to ease tidal commuting pressure.
items.title: 北京“十五五”规划：2030年轨道交通里程突破1050公里
items.title_en: Beijing's 15th Five-Year Plan: metro network to exceed 1,050 km by 2030

items.summary: 11月23日上午，市域（郊）铁路成眉线官塘站至煎茶站区间最后一榀预制箱梁精准落位，全线1544个墩柱、1181榀预制箱梁、91座现浇梁全部完成，桥梁主体结构连通，标志着成眉线实现全线贯通，建设重心随即全面转向轨道铺设、机电安装和车站装修等站后工程。成眉线全长59.139公里，起于成都红莲站、止于眉山东站，其中高架桥长46.18公里、占全长超八成，跨越岷江等江河；全线13座车站土建主体结构已全部完工，地下区间全部贯通，轨道铺设已完成60%。作为成德眉资同城化“2环3射”骨干通勤网络的重要项目，成眉线建成后将推动成都、眉山迈入“轨道同城”时代。
items.summary_en: On the morning of 23 November, the final prefabricated box girder was placed on the Guantang–Jiancha section of the Chengdu–Meishan suburban railway, completing all 1,544 piers, 1,181 box girders and 91 cast-in-place beams — the bridge structures are now fully connected, and construction shifts to track laying, electromechanical installation and station finishing. The 59.139 km line runs from Honglian in Chengdu to Meishan East, with 46.18 km of elevated viaduct crossing the Min River and other waterways; all 13 stations' civil structures are complete, underground sections are through, and 60% of track is laid. As a key part of the Chengdu–Deyang–Meishan–Ziyang "2 rings, 3 radials" commuter network, the line will bring Chengdu and Meishan into a single rail-connected twin-city era once open.
items.title: 市域（郊）铁路成眉线全线贯通

items.summary: 11月23日，上海市发展改革委发布优化后的轨道交通票价机制，将于12月1日起全面实施，这是上海地铁时隔21年首次调价。起乘价保持3元不变，但起乘里程由0至6公里缩短为0至4公里，此后按4、4、4、7、7、10、10公里递加1元，50公里以上每15公里加1元；叠加配套优惠后，平均每人次票价提高约0.9元。配套的4种计次票套餐已于11月26日起开售（35次190元、约5.43元/次；45次210元、约4.67元/次；60次270元、4.50元/次；90次390元、约4.33元/次，自激活日起30个自然日内有效、仅限本人实名使用），电子二维码形式可通过Metro大都会App、上海交通卡App、随申行App购买，实体银联卡形式可通过Metro大都会App、云闪付App购买；计次票与月满90元后9折优惠不同享，也不与公交换乘优惠同享。一日票、三日票分别调整为24元、60元；全网还将同步启用纸质二维码单程票，并支持上海火车站、南京西路等5个虚拟换乘站。
items.summary_en: On 23 November, Shanghai's Development and Reform Commission published a revised metro fare scheme taking effect on 1 December — the first fare adjustment in 21 years. The ¥3 base fare stays, but now covers only 0–4 km instead of 0–6 km, with ¥1 added per 4, 4, 4, 7, 7, 10 and 10 km thereafter and per 15 km beyond 50 km; after the accompanying discounts the average fare rises by about ¥0.9 per trip. The four multi-ride passes went on sale on 26 November (35 rides ¥190, about ¥5.43 per ride; 45 ¥210, about ¥4.67; 60 ¥270, ¥4.50; 90 ¥390, about ¥4.33; valid for 30 calendar days from activation for the named holder only): the e-QR versions are sold via the Metro Daduhui, Shanghai Transport Card and Suishenxing apps, and physical UnionPay-card versions via Metro Daduhui and Yunshanfu; the passes cannot be combined with the 10% discount after ¥90 monthly spending or with bus-transfer discounts. One-day and three-day passes move to ¥24 and ¥60, and paper QR single tickets and five virtual interchange stations go live network-wide.
items.title: 上海地铁12月1日起实施新票价，时隔21年首次调整
items.title_en: Shanghai metro fares change from 1 December, first adjustment in 21 years

items.summary: 为配合1号线二期北段及三期试运行工作，自11月23日起，石家庄地铁1号线各站首末班车时间调整，乘客需留意站内公示、合理安排出行。二期北段（福泽—东洋，3.1公里、2座车站）与三期（西王向西延伸，3.7公里、2座车站）均已进入试运行阶段，预计年底开通。两段开通后，1号线将向北延至东洋、向西延至槐安路方向，石家庄地铁的覆盖范围与运营里程将进一步扩大；地面公交也已启动配套优化意见征询，拟对17条线路调整接驳。
items.summary_en: To support trial operation on the northern section of Line 1 Phase 2 and on Phase 3, first and last train times on Shijiazhuang Metro Line 1 changed from 23 November, and passengers should check station notices. The Phase 2 north section (Fuze–Dongyang, 3.1 km, 2 stations) and Phase 3 (west from Xiwang, 3.7 km, 2 stations) are both in trial operation and expected to open by year-end. Once open, Line 1 will extend north to Dongyang and west towards Huai'an Road, widening the network's reach; the bus network has also opened consultation on feeder adjustments to 17 routes.
items.title: 石家庄1号线二期北段及三期进入试运行，11月23日起首末班车调整
items.title_en: Shijiazhuang Line 1 extensions enter trial operation; first/last train times change from 23 November

items.summary: 11月19日，合肥轨道交通S1线（合肥段）省中医院西区站至新桥2号航站楼站区段正式开通初期运营，全长31.3公里、设10座车站，采用GoA4全自动运行，首末班车为6:00至22:30，合肥西站至新桥2号航站楼站全程票价6元，合肥西站至机场约40余分钟。这是合肥十年间开通的第九条轨道交通线路，市区直达新桥机场的通勤通道就此成型；前往1号航站楼的旅客可在新桥2号航站楼站换乘机场免费接驳巴士。S1线全长47.5公里、共14座车站，五里墩站预计2027年开通，寿县段（寿县炎刘—新桥1号航站楼）预计2028年开通。
items.summary_en: On 19 November, the Hefei section of Hefei Metro Line S1 (Shengzhongyiyuan Xiqu – Xinqiao Terminal 2) opened for initial operation: 31.3 km with 10 stations, running in GoA4 fully automatic mode from 06:00 to 22:30, with a ¥6 full fare from Hefei West to Xinqiao Terminal 2 and a journey of just over 40 minutes. It is Hefei's ninth rail line in ten years and creates a direct city-centre-to-Xinqiao-Airport link; passengers for Terminal 1 can take the airport's free shuttle bus from Xinqiao Terminal 2 station. The full S1 line will run 47.5 km with 14 stations: Wulidun station is expected in 2027 and the Shouxian section (Shouxian Yanliu – Xinqiao Terminal 1) in 2028.
items.title: 合肥S1线（合肥段）开通运营，市区直达新桥机场
items.title_en: Hefei Line S1 (Hefei section) opens, linking the city centre to Xinqiao Airport

items.summary: 11月15日7时40分，乌鲁木齐城市轨道交通2号线一期工程北段开通初期运营，线路南起南门站、北至华山街站，全长约13.94公里、全部为地下线，共设10座车站（南门、中桥、碾子沟、南梁坡、农业大学、马料地、平川路、九家湾、乌鲁木齐站、华山街），其中南门站可与1号线换乘。线路运营时间为7:40至23:30，起步票价2元、全程票价4元，工作日早晚高峰约6分15秒一班、其余时段及周末约12分钟一班。2号线北段开通后，乌鲁木齐正式迈入双线换乘的“双地铁”时代，老城区与乌鲁木齐站之间的联系更加紧密。
items.summary_en: At 07:40 on 15 November, the northern section of Ürümqi Metro Line 2 Phase 1 opened for initial operation, running from Nanmen in the south to Huashan Street in the north: about 13.94 km, fully underground, with 10 stations (Nanmen, Zhongqiao, Nianzigou, Nanliangpo, Agricultural University, Maliaodi, Pingchuanlu, Jiujiawan, Ürümqi Railway Station and Huashan Street), interchanging with Line 1 at Nanmen. Services run from 07:40 to 23:30 with fares from ¥2 to a ¥4 full fare, at about 6 minutes 15 seconds in weekday peaks and about 12 minutes at other times and weekends. With the opening, Ürümqi enters a two-line interchange era, tightening links between the old city and Ürümqi Railway Station.
items.title: 乌鲁木齐地铁2号线北段开通运营，迈入“双地铁”时代
items.title_en: Ürümqi Metro Line 2 (north section) opens, ushering in a two-line era

items.summary: 据吉林省发展和改革委员会消息，长春轨道交通1号线南延工程已进入空载试运行阶段，采取分段开通方案：先期段红石、兴创路、兴博路、兴启路4站计划2026年底开通，柳家、永春南两站计划2027年底开通。南延线全长7公里，沿人民大街向南延伸，将扩大1号线服务范围，优化南部区域公共交通体系。
items.summary_en: According to the Jilin Provincial Development and Reform Commission, the south extension of Changchun Line 1 has entered no-load trial operation and will open in stages: the first four stations (Hongshi, Xingchuanglu, Xingbolu, Xingqilu) are planned to open by the end of 2026, with Liujia and Yongchunnan to follow by the end of 2027. The 7 km extension runs south along Renmin Avenue, widening Line 1's coverage and improving public transport in the city's south.
items.title: 长春1号线南延进入空载试运行，先期段预计年底开通
items.title_en: Changchun Line 1 south extension enters trial operation; first section expected by year-end
